country.description: Idealista country: Spain, Portugal, or Italy.
country.title: Country

location.description: City or area to search. Use the location slug from Idealista URLs. Spain: 'madrid-madrid', 'barcelona-barcelona', 'marbella-malaga'. Italy: 'roma-roma', 'milano-milano'. Portugal: 'lisboa', 'porto'. You can also paste a full Idealista search URL.
location.title: Location

maxItems.description: Maximum number of property listings to scrape. Leave empty for all available results (up to 1,800 per search).
maxItems.title: Maximum Properties

operation.description: Type of listing: properties for sale or for rent.
operation.title: Operation

propertyType.description: Type of property to search for.
propertyType.title: Property Type

proxyConfiguration.description: Apify Proxy is recommended. The actor uses a mirror-first fetch path and falls back to proxied requests when the mirror blocks direct cloud traffic.
proxyConfiguration.sectionDescription: Keep the default proxy settings for best cloud reliability.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration

startUrls.description: Direct Idealista search result page URLs (e.g. https://www.idealista.com/venta-viviendas/madrid-madrid/). When provided, these override the location/operation/propertyType fields. Individual property/listing detail page URLs are not supported yet and will be skipped.
startUrls.sectionDescription: Optionally provide Idealista search result page URLs directly instead of using the search fields above.
startUrls.title: Direct URLs
